2.text: You begin your journey on a dock leading to a collection of intertwined wooden platforms. Their stability is questionable but you must navigate them to complete your pilgrimage.

3.text: You climb the ramped staircase slippery with moss barely being able to see where you go next.

choices.text: You choose the path continuing forward ignoring the alternative and somewhat questionable path to your right.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You choose the path the right ignoring the simpler path forward.
choices.label: Continue this way

5.text: This path seems tretcherous but you've already made your decision. Although risky this way fills you with excitment.

6.text: You turn the corner, look down and see a path tilted, broken and sinking. You feel your decision has been made and you must continue.

7.text: You stumble across the decaying path, slipping and sliding before making it to the final hurdle, a jump to the much more secure rock in front of you.

choices.text: You made the jump safely but now another decision. You chose the path seemingly lowering again. You find comfort in being closer to the murky water below.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You made the jump safely but now another decision. You chose the path that seems simple as your last decision has made you cautious.
choices.label: Continue this way

9.text: You turn the first corner but before you do you look out into the nothingness of mist and dampness in the air. You don't know whether you feel fear or excitment.

10.text: You turn the next corner and find yourself under a tree in which you hear rustling above. You are to afraid to look up so you continue forward.

11.text: This path seems safe. You have steady footing but you worry that this path is too goof to be true. You continue forward anyway

choices.text: Another decision to make. You choose left. Looking ahead both paths seem to lead to the same place but your instincts led you this way.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: Another decision to make. You choose right. Looking ahead both paths seem to lead to the same place but your instincts led you this way.
choices.label: Continue this way

13.text: You turn the corner and realise you are approaching yet another decision. This path wasn't as simple as it first looked.

choices.text: You choose to continue forward making you last decision pointless but you feel comfort in that.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You choose to take the right which leads to a mossy rock. This makes your last decision feel worth it.
choices.label: Continue this way

15.text: You continue forward and start to notice that these paths lead to the mouth of a cave. You wonder if thats where you're supposed to go.

16.text: The closer you get to the mouth of the cave the more anxiety you feel. You're not sure if this is fear or excitment.

17.text: You're only a few steps from the entrance and as you take each one an overwhelming feeling of completion grows within you.

18.text: The cave is now calling your name. Your speed increases with excitment as you can't wait to discover what lays inside.

19.text: You're here, at the mouth of the cave. You take a break now finally on solid land and contimplate your next steps.

20.text: This path feels solid and simple yet you're not sure if this was the right direction to take.

21.text: You approach a corner with no railings and a rush of fear hits you. One slip on the moss and you're in. You feel that you must stick with your decision go for it.

22.text: This decision has led you to a large mossy stone in which multiple paths lead. You feel overwhelmed with decision but you wait to make up your mind until you reach the solid land.

23.text: Although this rock has multiple paths you see a cave in the distance and know this is the path you must take.

24.text: You realise this decision leads to a path in which your feet will get wet. The path is balancing on the water and you worry for your safety but continue anyway.

25.text: Although not the longest path it feels so. You are trying to both be cautious as to not miss a step and risk your life.

26.text: Although you know this is the path you must take as you approach you see its decay and start to doubt yourself. You push forward regardless.

27.text: You made it acoss the suprisingly stable titled paths and reach an incline over another large rock. The rock is obscuring your view but you have faith in your decision.

28.text: As you reach the sumit you are relived by a seemingly secure and simple path ahead leading directly to the mouth of the cave.

29.text: You are now fully within the tree canopy. Unidentifiable fruit hangs down but you must bat it away to continue on your journey.

30.text: You made it through the canopy and as you push the last leaves away you see that the path ahead has been damaged by a floating log. You choose to cross the log as a makeshift bridge as it seems to be lodged.

choices.text: The log didn't move and you made it safely across. You now choose to take a left as it seems to bring you closer to a solid piece of land and that log has made you weary.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: The log didn't move and you made it safely across. You choose to take a right as this path seems fully visible and you don't want anymore suprises.
choices.label: Continue this way

32.text: You were right and this path led directly to solid ground. A mossy rock with several paths leading to and from it.

33.text: This path feels relaxing. It is absent of risk and decision. You feel that you have nearly reached your goal.

34.text: As you continue you feel calmer and calmer but are aware that calmness can cause recklessness so are still vigilant. The cave mouth you feel holds your goal peaks in the distance.

35.text: Although not there yet you feel proud of you journey. You feel acomplished as well as relieved.

36.text: The last hurdle. A slight incline leading to the mouth of the cave. You are extra careful as to fail at the last hurdle would destry your spirit.

37.text: You have reached the mouth of the cave. You have no doubts and continue forward.
